TRY_REPLACE:sponsor_a_university = {
	estate = burghers_estate

	modifier_when_in_debate = {
		research_speed_modifier = 0.05
		monthly_towards_innovative = societal_value_huge_monthly_move #moves value by 3 over the duration
	}

	allow = {
		num_locations > 0
		has_advance = university_advance
		NOT = {
			has_estate_privilege = estate_privilege:clergy_lecture_oaths
		}
		any_owned_location = {
			is_core_of = root
			OR = {
				location_rank = location_rank:town
				location_rank = location_rank:city
				location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
			}
			NOT = { OR = { has_building = building_type:university has_building = building_type:tsin_research_university } }
		}
	}

	chance = {
		add = 1
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					societal_value:traditionalist_vs_innovative > 30
				}
				value = 2
			}
		}
		
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					tsin_total_university_levels < 1
				}
				value = 2
			}
		}
		multiply = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					societal_value:traditionalist_vs_innovative < 0
				}
				value = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = 1	#We need that else or otherwise the whole chance is multiplied with 0
			}
		}
	}
	
	on_debate_passed = {
		ordered_owned_location = {
			order_by = {
				value = population
				if = {
					limit = { OR = { location_rank = location_rank:city  location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis } }
					multiply = 5
				}
			}
			limit = {
				is_core_of = root
				NOT = { OR = { has_building = building_type:university has_building = building_type:tsin_research_university } }
				OR = {
					location_rank = location_rank:town
					location_rank = location_rank:city
					location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
				}
			}
			max = 1
			construct_building = {
				building_type = building_type:university
				cost_multiplier = 0.5
				cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_parliament_issue"
			}
			
		}
	}
	on_debate_failed = {
		parliament_debate_failed_effect = yes
	}
}

	modifier_when_in_debate = {
		global_pop_promotion_speed_modifier = 1
		global_monthly_prosperity = 0.1
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			current_age = age_4_reformation
			current_age = age_5_absolutism
			current_age_or_later = { age = age_6_revolutions }
		}
		is_subject = no
		at_war = no
		is_ai = no
		modifier:can_build_cities = yes
		num_locations > 1
		any_owned_non_rural_location = {
			location_rank = location_rank:town
			NOT = {
				any_neighbor_location = {
					owner ?= root
					OR = { location_rank = location_rank:city  location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	chance = {
		add = 1
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					num_locations > 5
				}
				value = 2
			}
		}
		multiply = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					num_of_non_rural > 20
				}
				value = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = 1	#We need that else or otherwise the whole chance is multiplied with 0
			}
		}
	}
	
	on_debate_passed = {
		ordered_owned_non_rural_location = {
			limit = {
				location_rank = location_rank:town
				NOT = {
					any_neighbor_location = {
						owner ?= root
						OR = { location_rank = location_rank:city  location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
					}
				}
			}
			order_by = {
				value = development
				add = population
				add = num_buildings
			}
			max = 1
			change_location_rank_effect = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
			change_development = development_weak_bonus
			every_pop = {
				limit = {
					owner = root
				}
				add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus
			}
		}
	}
	on_debate_failed = {
		parliament_debate_failed_effect = yes
	}

TRY_REPLACE:support_burgher_cabinet = {
	estate = burghers_estate

	modifier_when_in_debate = {
		country_cabinet_efficiency = 0.2
		global_pop_promotion_speed_modifier = 1
	}

	allow = {
		any_character = {
			in_cabinet = yes
			has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
		}
		NOR = {
			current_age = age_4_reformation
			current_age = age_5_absolutism
			current_age_or_later = { age = age_6_revolutions }
		}
	}

	chance = {
		add = 1
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_advance = government_size_renaissance
				}
				value = 2
			}
		}
		multiply = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					societal_value:aristocracy_vs_plutocracy < 0
				}
				value = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = 1	#We need that else or otherwise the whole chance is multiplied with 0
			}
		}
	}
	
	on_debate_passed = {
		random_cabinet_character = {
			limit = {
				has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
			}
			add_adm = 5
			add_dip = 5
			add_mil = 5
		}
		change_societal_value = {
			type = aristocracy_vs_plutocracy
			value = societal_value_move_to_right
		}
	}
	on_debate_failed = {
		parliament_debate_failed_effect = yes
	}
}
